name: sanitize-html
notes: Parser-based, server-first sanitizer. Default allowedTags excludes img and svg, so allowlists must be configured deliberately. The standalone repository is archived; development continues in the Apostrophe monorepo. No bundled types.

build_vs_buy.effort: do not build; years of adversarial testing
build_vs_buy.rationale: Parser-based sanitisation is a multi-year adversarial target; the buy is obvious.
